    <script>
        // ========== SOCKET.IO ==========
        const socket = io();

        // ========== MAP SETUP ==========
        let map;
        let currentMarker;
        let destinationMarker;
        let routeLayer = null;
        let watchId = null;
        let currentLat = -22.5609;
        let currentLng = 17.0658;
        let destLat = null;
        let destLng = null;
        let isNavigating = false;
        let gpsWatchActive = false;
        let voiceEnabled = true;
        let lastVoiceAnnouncement = '';
        let announcementCount = 0;
        let currentAccuracy = 0;
        let locationFound = false;

        // ========== LOCATION SENDER (SOCKET.IO) ==========
        let locationInterval = null;

        function startLocationUpdates() {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                console.warn('Geolocation not supported');
                return;
            }

            // Send initial location
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                (pos) => sendLocation(pos),
                (err) => console.warn('Initial location error:', err),
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
            );

            // Send every 3 seconds
            if (locationInterval) clearInterval(locationInterval);
            locationInterval = setInterval(() => {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    (pos) => sendLocation(pos),
                    (err) => console.warn('Location error:', err),
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
                );
            }, 3000);
        }

        function sendLocation(position) {
            const data = {
                latitude: position.coords.latitude,
                longitude: position.coords.longitude,
                accuracy: position.coords.accuracy,
                speed: position.coords.speed || 0
            };
            socket.emit('driver-location-update', data);
        }

        // ========== OFFLINE MAP SUPPORT ==========
        let useOfflineTiles = false;

        // ========== MAP INITIALIZATION ==========
        function initMap() {
            // First, check if offline tiles are available
            fetch('/api/tiles/status')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    useOfflineTiles = data.available;
                    console.log(`ðŸ—ºï¸ Using ${useOfflineTiles ? 'offline' : 'online'} tiles`);
                    proceedWithMapInit();
                })
                .catch(() => {
                    useOfflineTiles = false;
                    proceedWithMapInit();
                });
        }

        function proceedWithMapInit() {
            // Get initial location (if available)
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                        const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        currentLat = lat;
                        currentLng = lng;
                        locationFound = true;
                        setupMap(lat, lng);
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = 'Active';
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status active';
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        console.warn('Could not get initial location, using default:', error);
                        setupMap(-22.5609, 17.0658);
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ Click "My Location" to get GPS';
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            } else {
                setupMap(-22.5609, 17.0658);
                document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ GPS not supported';
            }

            // Load voices for speech synthesis
            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => {
                    window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                };
            }
        }

        function setupMap(lat, lng) {
            // Determine tile URL based on offline availability
            const tileUrl = useOfflineTiles 
                ? '/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png' 
                : 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';

            map = L.map('map', {
                center: [lat, lng],
                zoom: 16,
                zoomControl: true,
                attributionControl: true
            });

            // Add tile layer with offline support
            const tileLayer = L.tileLayer(tileUrl, {
                attribution: 'Â© OpenStreetMap contributors',
                maxZoom: 20
            }).addTo(map);

            // If offline tiles fail, switch to online
            if (useOfflineTiles) {
                tileLayer.on('tileerror', function() {
                    console.log('âš ï¸ Offline tile error, switching to online');
                    this.setUrl('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png');
                    this._onlineFallback = true;
                });
            }

            // Driver icon
            const driverIcon = L.divIcon({
                html: '<i class="bi bi-truck" style="font-size: 28px; color: #667eea;"></i>',
                iconSize: [28, 28],
                className: 'custom-icon'
            });

            currentMarker = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon: driverIcon }).addTo(map);
            currentMarker.bindPopup('ðŸ“ Your Location').openPopup();

            L.circle([lat, lng], {
                color: '#667eea',
                fillColor: '#667eea',
                fillOpacity: 0.1,
                radius: 50
            }).addTo(map);

            setTimeout(() => { map.invalidateSize(); }, 500);

            // Start GPS watch
            startGPSWatch();
            
            console.log(`ðŸ—ºï¸ Map initialized using ${useOfflineTiles ? 'offline' : 'online'} tiles`);
        }

        // ========== GPS WATCH ==========
        function startGPSWatch() {
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                if (watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);
                watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                        const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        const accuracy = position.coords.accuracy;
                        const speed = position.coords.speed || 0;
                        currentLat = lat;
                        currentLng = lng;
                        currentAccuracy = accuracy;

                        // Update marker
                        currentMarker.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
                        currentMarker.bindPopup(`ðŸ“ Your Location<br>Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`).openPopup();

                        // Update accuracy circle
                        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                            if (layer instanceof L.Circle) map.removeLayer(layer);
                        });
                        L.circle([lat, lng], {
                            color: '#667eea',
                            fillColor: '#667eea',
                            fillOpacity: 0.1,
                            radius: accuracy
                        }).addTo(map);

                        // Update display
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('accuracyDisplay').textContent = `Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`;

                        // Update GPS status
                        let statusText = '';
                        if (accuracy < 20) statusText = 'Excellent';
                        else if (accuracy < 50) statusText = 'Good';
                        else if (accuracy < 100) statusText = 'Fair';
                        else statusText = 'Poor';
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = statusText;
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status active';

                        // If navigating, update route
                        if (isNavigating && destLat && destLng) {
                            const distance = calculateDistance(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                            showRoute(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                            updateDirection(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                            if (voiceEnabled) {
                                if (distance < 1 && distance > 0.1 && announcementCount % 5 === 0) {
                                    speakText(`You are ${Math.round(distance * 1000)} meters from your destination`);
                                } else if (distance <= 0.1 && distance > 0.01) {
                                    speakText(`You have arrived at your destination`);
                                } else if (distance > 1 && Math.round(distance) % 5 === 0 && announcementCount % 10 === 0) {
                                    speakText(`You are ${Math.round(distance)} kilometers from your destination`);
                                }
                                announcementCount++;
                            }
                        }
                        if (isNavigating) map.setView([lat, lng], 17);
                        locationFound = true;
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        console.error('GPS watch error:', error);
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status inactive';
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = 'Error';
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 15000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            }
        }

        // ========== VOICE & NAVIGATION FUNCTIONS ==========
        function speakText(text) {
            if (!voiceEnabled) return;
            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
                const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
                utterance.lang = 'en-US';
                utterance.rate = 0.9;
                utterance.pitch = 1;
                utterance.volume = 1;
                const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                const femaleVoice = voices.find(voice =>
                    voice.name.includes('Google UK') || voice.name.includes('Samantha') || voice.name.includes('Female')
                );
                if (femaleVoice) utterance.voice = femaleVoice;
                window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
            }
        }

        function toggleVoice() {
            voiceEnabled = !voiceEnabled;
            const btn = document.getElementById('voiceToggleBtn');
            const indicator = document.getElementById('voiceIndicator');
            const status = document.getElementById('voiceStatus');
            if (voiceEnabled) {
                indicator.className = 'voice-indicator active';
                status.textContent = 'Voice';
                speakText('Voice navigation enabled');
            } else {
                indicator.className = 'voice-indicator inactive';
                status.textContent = 'Mute';
                window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            }
        }

        function getCurrentLocation() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('gpsStatus');
            const statusText = document.getElementById('gpsStatusText');
            statusEl.className = 'gps-status searching';
            statusText.textContent = 'Getting location...';
            document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ Getting location...';
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                        const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        const accuracy = position.coords.accuracy;
                        map.setView([lat, lng], 17);
                        currentMarker.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
                        currentMarker.bindPopup(`ðŸ“ Your Location<br>Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`).openPopup();
                        currentLat = lat;
                        currentLng = lng;
                        locationFound = true;
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('accuracyDisplay').textContent = `Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`;
                        statusEl.className = 'gps-status active';
                        statusText.textContent = 'Active';
                        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                            if (layer instanceof L.Circle) map.removeLayer(layer);
                        });
                        L.circle([lat, lng], {
                            color: '#667eea',
                            fillColor: '#667eea',
                            fillOpacity: 0.1,
                            radius: accuracy
                        }).addTo(map);
                        if (voiceEnabled) speakText(`Location found. Accuracy ${Math.round(accuracy)} meters.`);
                        if (isNavigating && destLat && destLng) {
                            showRoute(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                            updateDirection(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                        }
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        let errorMsg = 'Unable to get location. ';
                        switch(error.code) {
                            case error.PERMISSION_DENIED: errorMsg += 'Please allow location access.'; break;
                            case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: errorMsg += 'Location information is unavailable.'; break;
                            case error.TIMEOUT: errorMsg += 'The request timed out.'; break;
                            default: errorMsg += 'Please try again.';
                        }
                        statusEl.className = 'gps-status inactive';
                        statusText.textContent = 'Error';
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ ' + errorMsg;
                        alert('âš ï¸ ' + errorMsg);
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 30000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            } else {
                alert('âš ï¸ Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
            }
        }

        function calculateDistance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
            const R = 6371;
            const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const a = Math.sin(dLat/2) * Math.sin(dLat/2) +
                      Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
                      Math.sin(dLon/2) * Math.sin(dLon/2);
            const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1-a));
            return R * c;
        }

        function navigateToDestination(orderId, lat, lng, location, patientName, patientPhone) {
            const latNum = parseFloat(lat);
            const lngNum = parseFloat(lng);
            if (!latNum || !lngNum || isNaN(latNum) || isNaN(lngNum)) {
                alert('No location coordinates available for this order.');
                return;
            }
            destLat = latNum;
            destLng = lngNum;
            isNavigating = true;
            announcementCount = 0;
            document.getElementById('deliveryLocation').textContent = `${location}`;
            if (destinationMarker) map.removeLayer(destinationMarker);
            const destIcon = L.divIcon({
                html: '<i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill" style="font-size: 32px; color: #dc3545;"></i>',
                iconSize: [32, 32],
                className: 'custom-icon'
            });
            destinationMarker = L.marker([latNum, lngNum], { icon: destIcon }).addTo(map);
            destinationMarker.bindPopup(`<strong>ðŸ“ ${patientName}</strong><br>${location}`).openPopup();
            const distance = calculateDistance(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);
            showRoute(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);
            updateDirection(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);
            const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[currentLat, currentLng], [latNum, lngNum]]);
            map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30] });
            document.getElementById('routeInfo').style.display = 'block';
            if (voiceEnabled) speakText(`Navigating to ${patientName}. Distance ${distance.toFixed(1)} kilometers.`);
        }

        function showRoute(startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng) {
            const url = `https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/${startLng},${startLat};${endLng},${endLat}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`;
            fetch(url)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.code === 'Ok' && data.routes && data.routes.length > 0) {
                        const route = data.routes[0];
                        const geometry = route.geometry;
                        const coordinates = geometry.coordinates.map(coord => [coord[1], coord[0]]);
                        if (routeLayer) map.removeLayer(routeLayer);
                        routeLayer = L.polyline(coordinates, {
                            color: '#667eea',
                            weight: 4,
                            opacity: 0.8
                        }).addTo(map);
                        const distance = route.distance / 1000;
                        const duration = route.duration / 60;
                        document.getElementById('distance').textContent = distance.toFixed(1) + ' km';
                        if (duration < 60) {
                            document.getElementById('duration').textContent = Math.round(duration) + ' min';
                        } else {
                            const hours = Math.floor(duration / 60);
                            const mins = Math.round(duration % 60);
                            document.getElementById('duration').textContent = hours + 'h ' + mins + 'm';
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Route error:', error);
                    document.getElementById('distance').textContent = 'Route unavailable';
                    document.getElementById('duration').textContent = '-';
                });
        }

        function updateDirection(startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng) {
            const dLat = endLat - startLat;
            const dLng = endLng - startLng;
            let angle = Math.atan2(dLng, dLat) * 180 / Math.PI;
            angle = (angle + 360) % 360;
            const directions = ['N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SW', 'W', 'NW'];
            const index = Math.round(angle / 45) % 8;
            document.getElementById('direction').textContent = directions[index] + ` (${Math.round(angle)}Â°)`;
        }

        function showLocationOnMap(lat, lng, address) {
            if (lat && lng && !isNaN(parseFloat(lat)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lng))) {
                window.open(`https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${lat}&mlon=${lng}&zoom=15`, '_blank');
            } else if (address) {
                window.open(`https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(address)}`, '_blank');
            }
        }

        function resetMapView() {
            if (currentLat && currentLng) {
                map.setView([currentLat, currentLng], 16);
                currentMarker.bindPopup('ðŸ“ Your Location').openPopup();
            }
        }

        function viewOrder(id) {
            fetch(`/driver/order/${id}`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.success) {
                        const order = data.order;
                        alert(`Order: ${order.prescriptionName}\nPatient: ${order.patientName}\nLocation: ${order.location}\nStatus: ${order.status}`);
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    alert('Failed to load order details');
                });
        }

        function updateOrderStatus(orderId, status) {
            document.getElementById('statusOrderId').value = orderId;
            document.getElementById('statusValue').value = status;
            document.getElementById('statusForm').submit();
        }

        function markDelivered(orderId) {
            if (confirm('Mark this order as delivered?')) {
                updateOrderStatus(orderId, 'delivered');
                if (voiceEnabled) speakText('Order marked as delivered');
            }
        }

        // ========== INIT ==========
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // Auto-dismiss flash messages
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });

            initMap();
            startLocationUpdates(); // Start Socket.io location sending

            // Stop tracking on page unload
            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
                if (locationInterval) clearInterval(locationInterval);
            });
        });
    </script>

        function testSMS() {
            fetch('/nurse/sms/test')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.success) {
                        alert('âœ… SMS connection successful!');
                    } else {
                        alert('âŒ SMS connection failed: ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error'));
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    alert('âŒ Error testing SMS: ' + err.message);
                });
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Toggle password visibility
        function togglePassword(inputId, toggleId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const toggle = document.getElementById(toggleId);
            
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye';
            }
        }

        // Check password strength
        function checkPasswordStrength(password) {
            const strengthBar = document.getElementById('passwordStrength');
            let strength = 0;

            // Check requirements
            const hasLength = password.length >= 6;
            const hasLowercase = /[a-z]/.test(password);
            const hasUppercase = /[A-Z]/.test(password);
            const hasNumber = /[0-9]/.test(password);
            const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(password);

            // Update requirement indicators
            updateRequirement('reqLength', hasLength);
            updateRequirement('reqLowercase', hasLowercase);
            updateRequirement('reqUppercase', hasUppercase);
            updateRequirement('reqNumber', hasNumber);
            updateRequirement('reqSpecial', hasSpecial);

            // Calculate strength
            if (hasLength) strength++;
            if (hasLowercase) strength++;
            if (hasUppercase) strength++;
            if (hasNumber) strength++;
            if (hasSpecial) strength++;

            // Set color and width
            if (password.length === 0) {
                strengthBar.style.backgroundColor = '';
                strengthBar.style.width = '0%';
            } else if (strength <= 2) {
                strengthBar.style.backgroundColor = '#dc3545';
                strengthBar.style.width = '20%';
            } else if (strength === 3) {
                strengthBar.style.backgroundColor = '#ffc107';
                strengthBar.style.width = '50%';
            } else if (strength === 4) {
                strengthBar.style.backgroundColor = '#17a2b8';
                strengthBar.style.width = '75%';
            } else {
                strengthBar.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745';
                strengthBar.style.width = '100%';
            }

            checkPasswordMatch();
        }

        // Update requirement indicator
        function updateRequirement(id, isValid) {
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            const text = element.textContent.replace(/[âœ“âœ—]/g, '').trim();
            if (isValid) {
                element.className = 'valid';
                element.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> ' + text;
            } else {
                element.className = 'invalid';
                element.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ' + text;
            }
        }

        // Check if passwords match
        function checkPasswordMatch() {
            const newPassword = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            const matchIndicator = document.getElementById('passwordMatch');

            if (confirmPassword.length === 0) {
                matchIndicator.textContent = '';
                matchIndicator.className = 'text-muted';
                return;
            }

            if (newPassword === confirmPassword) {
                matchIndicator.textContent = 'âœ“ Passwords match!';
                matchIndicator.className = 'text-success';
            } else {
                matchIndicator.textContent = 'âœ— Passwords do not match';
                matchIndicator.className = 'text-danger';
            }
        }

        // Form validation
        document.getElementById('changePasswordForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const currentPassword = document.getElementById('currentPassword').value;
            const newPassword = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;

            if (!currentPassword || !newPassword || !confirmPassword) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Please fill in all fields');
                return false;
            }

            if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Passwords do not match!');
                return false;
            }

            if (newPassword.length < 6) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Password must be at least 6 characters');
                return false;
            }

            const hasLowercase = /[a-z]/.test(newPassword);
            const hasUppercase = /[A-Z]/.test(newPassword);
            const hasNumber = /[0-9]/.test(newPassword);
            const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(newPassword);

            if (!hasLowercase || !hasUppercase || !hasNumber || !hasSpecial) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Password must contain at least one lowercase, uppercase, number, and special character');
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        });

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const alerts = document.querySelectorAll('.alert');
            alerts.forEach(alert => {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    alert.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    alert.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        alert.style.display = 'none';
                    }, 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // ========== SOCKET.IO ==========
        const socket = io();

        socket.on('connect', () => {
            console.log('âœ… [Socket.IO] Connected â€” id:', socket.id);
        });
        socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => {
            console.warn('âš ï¸ [Socket.IO] Disconnected:', reason);
        });
        socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
            console.error('âŒ [Socket.IO] Connection error:', err.message);
        });

        // ========== STATE ==========
        let map;
        let currentMarker;
        let destinationMarker;
        let routeLayer = null;
        let watchId = null;
        let currentLat = -22.5609;
        let currentLng = 17.0658;
        let destLat = null;
        let destLng = null;
        let isNavigating = false;
        let voiceEnabled = true;
        let announcementCount = 0;
        let currentAccuracy = 0;
        let locationFound = false;
        let lastEmitTime = 0;
        const EMIT_INTERVAL_MS = 2000;

        // ========== SMOOTH MARKER ANIMATION ==========
        function moveMarkerSmoothly(marker, newLat, newLng, duration) {
            duration = duration || 2000;
            const start = marker.getLatLng();
            const end = L.latLng(newLat, newLng);
            const startTime = performance.now();

            if (start.distanceTo(end) < 1) {
                marker.setLatLng(end);
                return;
            }

            function step(now) {
                const t = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
                const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
                const lat = start.lat + (end.lat - start.lat) * eased;
                const lng = start.lng + (end.lng - start.lng) * eased;
                marker.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
                if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }

        // ========== UNIFIED GPS WATCH ==========
        function startGPSWatch() {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                console.warn('âŒ Geolocation not supported');
                return;
            }

            if (watchId !== null) navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);

            watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
                function(position) {
                    const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                    const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                    const accuracy = position.coords.accuracy;
                    const speed = position.coords.speed || 0;

                    currentLat = lat;
                    currentLng = lng;
                    currentAccuracy = accuracy;

                    if (currentMarker) {
                        moveMarkerSmoothly(currentMarker, lat, lng, 2000);
                        currentMarker.bindPopup(`ðŸ“ Your Location<br>Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`);
                    }

                    map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
                        if (layer instanceof L.Circle) map.removeLayer(layer);
                    });
                    L.circle([lat, lng], {
                        color: '#667eea',
                        fillColor: '#667eea',
                        fillOpacity: 0.1,
                        radius: accuracy
                    }).addTo(map);

                    document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                    document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                    document.getElementById('accuracyDisplay').textContent = `Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`;

                    let statusText = 'Poor';
                    if (accuracy < 20) statusText = 'Excellent';
                    else if (accuracy < 50) statusText = 'Good';
                    else if (accuracy < 100) statusText = 'Fair';
                    document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = statusText;
                    document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status active';

                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastEmitTime >= EMIT_INTERVAL_MS) {
                        lastEmitTime = now;
                        if (socket && socket.connected) {
                            socket.emit('driver-location-update', {
                                latitude: lat,
                                longitude: lng,
                                accuracy: accuracy,
                                speed: speed,
                                timestamp: now
                            });
                            console.log('ðŸ“ Sent:', lat.toFixed(5), lng.toFixed(5), 'Â±' + Math.round(accuracy) + 'm');
                        } else {
                            console.warn('âš ï¸ Socket not connected â€” skipping emit');
                        }
                    }

                    if (isNavigating && destLat && destLng) {
                        const distance = calculateDistance(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                        showRoute(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                        updateDirection(lat, lng, destLat, destLng);
                        if (voiceEnabled) {
                            if (distance < 1 && distance > 0.1 && announcementCount % 5 === 0) {
                                speakText(`You are ${Math.round(distance * 1000)} meters from your destination`);
                            } else if (distance <= 0.1 && distance > 0.01) {
                                speakText(`You have arrived at your destination`);
                            } else if (distance > 1 && Math.round(distance) % 5 === 0 && announcementCount % 10 === 0) {
                                speakText(`You are ${Math.round(distance)} kilometers from your destination`);
                            }
                            announcementCount++;
                        }
                        map.setView([lat, lng], 17);
                    }
                },
                function(error) {
                    console.error('âŒ GPS error:', error.code, error.message);
                    if (error.code === 1) {
                        console.error('   â†’ Driver must allow location permission');
                    }
                    document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status inactive';
                    document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = 'Error';
                },
                {
                    enableHighAccuracy: true,
                    timeout: 15000,
                    maximumAge: 0
                }
            );

            console.log('ðŸ“ watchPosition started â€” smooth glide @ ' + EMIT_INTERVAL_MS + 'ms');
        }

        // ========== MAP INITIALIZATION ==========
        function initMap() {
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        currentLat = position.coords.latitude;
                        currentLng = position.coords.longitude;
                        setupMap(currentLat, currentLng);
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${currentLat.toFixed(6)}, ${currentLng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${currentLat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${currentLng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatusText').textContent = 'Active';
                        document.getElementById('gpsStatus').className = 'gps-status active';
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        console.warn('Could not get initial location:', error.message);
                        setupMap(-22.5609, 17.0658);
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ Click "My Location" to get GPS';
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
                );
            } else {
                setupMap(-22.5609, 17.0658);
                document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ GPS not supported';
            }

            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => {
                    window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                };
            }
        }

        function setupMap(lat, lng) {
            map = L.map('map', {
                center: [lat, lng],
                zoom: 14,
                zoomControl: true,
                attributionControl: true
            });

            L.tileLayer('/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
                attribution: 'Offline Map',
                maxZoom: 19,
                maxNativeZoom: 16,
                errorTileUrl: 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8//8/AwAI/AL+fH5B4AAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='
            }).addTo(map);

            const driverIcon = L.divIcon({
                html: '<i class="bi bi-truck" style="font-size: 28px; color: #667eea;"></i>',
                iconSize: [28, 28],
                className: 'custom-icon'
            });

            currentMarker = L.marker([lat, lng], { icon: driverIcon }).addTo(map);
            currentMarker.bindPopup('ðŸ“ Your Location').openPopup();

            L.circle([lat, lng], {
                color: '#667eea',
                fillColor: '#667eea',
                fillOpacity: 0.1,
                radius: 50
            }).addTo(map);

            setTimeout(() => { map.invalidateSize(); }, 500);

            startGPSWatch();
            console.log('ðŸ—ºï¸ Map initialized â€” starting smooth GPS watch');
        }

        // ========== VOICE ==========
        function speakText(text) {
            if (!voiceEnabled) return;
            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
                const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
                utterance.lang = 'en-US';
                utterance.rate = 0.9;
                utterance.pitch = 1;
                utterance.volume = 1;
                const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
                const femaleVoice = voices.find(voice =>
                    voice.name.includes('Google UK') || voice.name.includes('Samantha') || voice.name.includes('Female')
                );
                if (femaleVoice) utterance.voice = femaleVoice;
                window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
            }
        }

        function toggleVoice() {
            voiceEnabled = !voiceEnabled;
            const indicator = document.getElementById('voiceIndicator');
            const status = document.getElementById('voiceStatus');
            if (voiceEnabled) {
                indicator.className = 'voice-indicator active';
                status.textContent = 'Voice';
                speakText('Voice navigation enabled');
            } else {
                indicator.className = 'voice-indicator inactive';
                status.textContent = 'Mute';
                window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            }
        }

        // ========== MANUAL LOCATION FETCH ==========
        function getCurrentLocation() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('gpsStatus');
            const statusText = document.getElementById('gpsStatusText');
            statusEl.className = 'gps-status searching';
            statusText.textContent = 'Getting location...';
            document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ Getting location...';

            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                        const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        const accuracy = position.coords.accuracy;

                        map.setView([lat, lng], 17);
                        if (currentMarker) {
                            moveMarkerSmoothly(currentMarker, lat, lng, 500);
                            currentMarker.bindPopup(`ðŸ“ Your Location<br>Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`).openPopup();
                        }
                        currentLat = lat;
                        currentLng = lng;
                        locationFound = true;

                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = `${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('locationCoords').textContent = `Lat: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, Lng: ${lng.toFixed(6)}`;
                        document.getElementById('accuracyDisplay').textContent = `Accuracy: ${Math.round(accuracy)}m`;
                        statusEl.className = 'gps-status active';
                        statusText.textContent = 'Active';

                        if (socket && socket.connected) {
                            socket.emit('driver-location-update', {
                                latitude: lat,
                                longitude: lng,
                                accuracy: accuracy,
                                speed: 0,
                                timestamp: Date.now()
                            });
                            console.log('ðŸ“ Manual emit:', lat.toFixed(5), lng.toFixed(5));
                        }

                        if (voiceEnabled) speakText(`Location found. Accuracy ${Math.round(accuracy)} meters.`);
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        let errorMsg = 'Unable to get location. ';
                        switch(error.code) {
                            case error.PERMISSION_DENIED: errorMsg += 'Please allow location access.'; break;
                            case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: errorMsg += 'Location information is unavailable.'; break;
                            case error.TIMEOUT: errorMsg += 'The request timed out.'; break;
                            default: errorMsg += 'Please try again.';
                        }
                        statusEl.className = 'gps-status inactive';
                        statusText.textContent = 'Error';
                        document.getElementById('currentLocation').textContent = 'ðŸ“ ' + errorMsg;
                        alert('âš ï¸ ' + errorMsg);
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 30000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            } else {
                alert('âš ï¸ Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
            }
        }

        function calculateDistance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
            const R = 6371;
            const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const a = Math.sin(dLat/2) * Math.sin(dLat/2) +
                      Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
                      Math.sin(dLon/2) * Math.sin(dLon/2);
            const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1-a));
            return R * c;
        }

        function navigateToDestination(orderId, lat, lng, location, patientName, patientPhone) {
            const latNum = parseFloat(lat);
            const lngNum = parseFloat(lng);
            if (!latNum || !lngNum || isNaN(latNum) || isNaN(lngNum)) {
                alert('No location coordinates available for this order.');
                return;
            }
            destLat = latNum;
            destLng = lngNum;
            isNavigating = true;
            announcementCount = 0;
            document.getElementById('deliveryLocation').textContent = location;

            if (destinationMarker) map.removeLayer(destinationMarker);
            const destIcon = L.divIcon({
                html: '<i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill" style="font-size: 32px; color: #dc3545;"></i>',
                iconSize: [32, 32],
                className: 'custom-icon'
            });
            destinationMarker = L.marker([latNum, lngNum], { icon: destIcon }).addTo(map);
            destinationMarker.bindPopup(`<strong>ðŸ“ ${patientName}</strong><br>${location}`).openPopup();

            const distance = calculateDistance(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);
            showRoute(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);
            updateDirection(currentLat, currentLng, latNum, lngNum);

            const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[currentLat, currentLng], [latNum, lngNum]]);
            map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [30, 30] });
            document.getElementById('routeInfo').style.display = 'block';

            if (voiceEnabled) speakText(`Navigating to ${patientName}. Distance ${distance.toFixed(1)} kilometers.`);
        }

        function showRoute(startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng) {
            const url = 'https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/' + startLng + ',' + startLat + ';' + endLng + ',' + endLat + '?overview=full&geometries=geojson';
            fetch(url)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.code === 'Ok' && data.routes && data.routes.length > 0) {
                        const route = data.routes[0];
                        const coordinates = route.geometry.coordinates.map(coord => [coord[1], coord[0]]);
                        if (routeLayer) map.removeLayer(routeLayer);
                        routeLayer = L.polyline(coordinates, {
                            color: '#667eea',
                            weight: 4,
                            opacity: 0.8
                        }).addTo(map);

                        const distance = route.distance / 1000;
                        const duration = route.duration / 60;
                        document.getElementById('distance').textContent = distance.toFixed(1) + ' km';
                        if (duration < 60) {
                            document.getElementById('duration').textContent = Math.round(duration) + ' min';
                        } else {
                            const hours = Math.floor(duration / 60);
                            const mins = Math.round(duration % 60);
                            document.getElementById('duration').textContent = hours + 'h ' + mins + 'm';
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Route error:', error);
                    document.getElementById('distance').textContent = 'Route unavailable';
                    document.getElementById('duration').textContent = '-';
                });
        }

        function updateDirection(startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng) {
            const dLat = endLat - startLat;
            const dLng = endLng - startLng;
            let angle = Math.atan2(dLng, dLat) * 180 / Math.PI;
            angle = (angle + 360) % 360;
            const directions = ['N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SW', 'W', 'NW'];
            const index = Math.round(angle / 45) % 8;
            document.getElementById('direction').textContent = directions[index] + ' (' + Math.round(angle) + 'Â°)';
        }

        function showLocationOnMap(lat, lng, address) {
            if (lat && lng && !isNaN(parseFloat(lat)) && !isNaN(parseFloat(lng))) {
                window.open('https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=' + lat + '&mlon=' + lng + '&zoom=15', '_blank');
            } else if (address) {
                window.open('https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=' + encodeURIComponent(address), '_blank');
            }
        }

        function resetMapView() {
            if (currentLat && currentLng) {
                map.setView([currentLat, currentLng], 14);
                if (currentMarker) currentMarker.bindPopup('ðŸ“ Your Location').openPopup();
            }
        }

        function viewOrder(id) {
            fetch('/driver/order/' + id)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.success) {
                        const order = data.order;
                        let msg = 'Patient: ' + order.patientName + '\n';
                        msg += 'Phone: ' + order.patientPhone + '\n';
                        msg += 'Location: ' + order.location + '\n';
                        msg += 'Status: ' + order.status;
                        if (order.deliveryDate) {
                            msg += '\nDelivered: ' + new Date(order.deliveryDate).toLocaleString();
                        }
                        alert(msg);
                    } else {
                        alert('Order not found');
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    alert('Failed to load order details');
                });
        }

        function updateOrderStatus(orderId, status) {
            document.getElementById('statusOrderId').value = orderId;
            document.getElementById('statusValue').value = status;
            document.getElementById('statusForm').submit();
        }

        function markDelivered(orderId) {
            if (confirm('Mark this order as delivered?')) {
                updateOrderStatus(orderId, 'delivered');
                if (voiceEnabled) speakText('Order marked as delivered');
            }
        }

        // ========== ORDER UPDATES â€” toast, no reload ==========
        socket.on('data-updated', (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'order') {
                console.log('ðŸ“¦ Order update received â€” showing toast');
                const notify = document.createElement('div');
                notify.textContent = 'ðŸ“¦ New order update â€” refresh to see';

        const subjectInput = document.getElementById('subject');
        const messageInput = document.getElementById('message');
        const preview = document.getElementById('preview');

        // Character counters
        subjectInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const counter = document.getElementById('subjectCount');
            counter.textContent = count + ' / 80 characters';
            counter.className = 'text-muted char-counter ' +
                (count > 70 ? 'danger' : count > 55 ? 'warning' : 'success');
            updatePreview();
        });

        messageInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const counter = document.getElementById('messageCount');
            counter.textContent = count + ' / 500 characters';
            counter.className = 'text-muted char-counter ' +
                (count > 450 ? 'danger' : count > 350 ? 'warning' : 'success');
            updatePreview();
        });

        // Live preview
        function updatePreview() {
            const subject = subjectInput.value.trim() || 'Your subject here';
            const message = messageInput.value.trim() || 'Your message here...';
            preview.innerHTML = 'ðŸ“¢ ' + escapeHtml(subject) + '\n\n' + escapeHtml(message);
        }

        // Escape HTML in preview (prevents XSS inside the preview box)
        function escapeHtml(str) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = str;
            return div.innerHTML;
        }

        // Form validation before submit
        document.getElementById('announcementForm').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            const subject = subjectInput.value.trim();
            const message = messageInput.value.trim();
            if (subject.length < 3) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Subject must be at least 3 characters');
                return false;
            }
            if (message.length < 10) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Message must be at least 10 characters');
                return false;
            }
            // Confirm before sending
            const confirmed = confirm(
                'Send this announcement to all patients with a phone number? This cannot be undone.'
            );
            if (!confirmed) {
                e.preventDefault();
                return false;
            }
            // Disable the button to prevent doubleâ€‘submit
            document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = true;
            document.getElementById('submitBtn').innerHTML =
                '<i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Sending...';
            return true;
        });

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert:not(.alert-info)').forEach(function (a) {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(function () { a.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        function togglePassword(inputId, toggleId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const toggle = document.getElementById(toggleId);
            if (input.type === 'password') { input.type = 'text'; toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash'; }
            else { input.type = 'password'; toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye'; }
        }
        function validateNewPassword(password) {
            const checks = {
                reqLength: password.length >= 6,
                reqLowercase: /[a-z]/.test(password),
                reqUppercase: /[A-Z]/.test(password),
                reqNumber: /[0-9]/.test(password),
                reqSpecial: /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(password)
            };
            Object.keys(checks).forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                const text = el.textContent.replace(/[âœ“âœ—]/g,'').trim();
                if (checks[id]) { el.className = 'valid'; el.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> ' + text; }
                else { el.className = 'invalid'; el.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ' + text; }
            });
            const bar = document.getElementById('passwordStrength');
            let strength = Object.values(checks).filter(Boolean).length;
            if (password.length === 0) { bar.style.width = '0%'; bar.style.backgroundColor = ''; }
            else if (strength <= 2) { bar.style.width = '20%'; bar.style.backgroundColor = '#dc3545'; }
            else if (strength === 3) { bar.style.width = '50%'; bar.style.backgroundColor = '#ffc107'; }
            else if (strength === 4) { bar.style.width = '75%'; bar.style.backgroundColor = '#17a2b8'; }
            else { bar.style.width = '100%'; bar.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745'; }
            checkPasswordMatch();
        }
        function checkPasswordMatch() {
            const n = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const c = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            const m = document.getElementById('passwordMatch');
            if (c.length === 0) { m.textContent = ''; m.className = 'text-muted'; return; }
            if (n === c) { m.textContent = 'âœ“ Passwords match!'; m.className = 'text-success'; }
            else { m.textContent = 'âœ— Passwords do not match'; m.className = 'text-danger'; }
        }
        function validateForm() {
            const n = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const c = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            if (n.length < 6) { alert('Password must be at least 6 characters'); return false; }
            if (!/[a-z]/.test(n) || !/[A-Z]/.test(n) || !/[0-9]/.test(n) || !/[!@#$%^&*]/.test(n)) {
                alert('Password must contain lowercase, uppercase, number, and special character'); return false;
            }
            if (n !== c) { alert('Passwords do not match'); return false; }
            return true;
        }
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => { a.style.transition='opacity 0.5s'; a.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>a.style.display='none',500); }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Calculate age on date of birth change
        document.getElementById('dateOfBirth').addEventListener('change', function() {
            const dob = new Date(this.value);
            if (dob) {
                const today = new Date();
                let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
                const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
                if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.getDate())) {
                    age--;
                }
                document.getElementById('age').value = age;
            }
        });

        // Filter drivers
        function filterDrivers(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.driver-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        function viewDriver(id) { window.location.href = `/nurse/driver/${id}`; }
        function editDriver(id) { window.location.href = `/nurse/driver/edit/${id}`; }
        function deleteDriver(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this driver? This action cannot be undone.')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/nurse/driver/delete/${id}`;

                // âœ… CSRF token for the POST request
                const csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                csrfInput.value = '<%= typeof csrfToken !== "undefined" ? csrfToken : (typeof csrf !== "undefined" ? csrf : "") %>';
                form.appendChild(csrfInput);

                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // ========== COPY FUNCTIONS ==========
        function copyPassword() {
            const password = document.getElementById('driverPassword').textContent;
            if (password && password !== 'Password not available') {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(password).then(() => alert('âœ… Password copied to clipboard!'))
                    .catch(() => {
                        const input = document.createElement('input');
                        input.value = password;
                        document.body.appendChild(input);
                        input.select();
                        document.execCommand('copy');
                        document.body.removeChild(input);
                        alert('âœ… Password copied to clipboard!');
                    });
            } else {
                alert('âš ï¸ Password not available. Please reset the password.');
            }
        }

        function copyCredentials() {
            const email = '<%= driver.email %>';
            const password = document.getElementById('driverPassword').textContent;
            const loginUrl = 'http://localhost:3000/driver/login';
            if (password && password !== 'Password not available') {
                const text = `ðŸ” Driver Login Credentials\n\nEmail: ${email}\nPassword: ${password}\nLogin URL: ${loginUrl}`;
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => alert('âœ… All credentials copied!'))
                    .catch(() => {
                        const input = document.createElement('input');
                        input.value = text;
                        document.body.appendChild(input);
                        input.select();
                        document.execCommand('copy');
                        document.body.removeChild(input);
                        alert('âœ… All credentials copied!');
                    });
            } else {
                alert('âš ï¸ Password not available. Please reset the password first.');
            }
        }

        function copyLoginUrl() {
            const url = 'http://localhost:3000/driver/login';
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => alert('âœ… Login URL copied!'))
                .catch(() => {
                    const input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.value = url;
                    document.body.appendChild(input);
                    input.select();
                    document.execCommand('copy');
                    document.body.removeChild(input);
                    alert('âœ… Login URL copied!');
                });
        }

        // ========== MODAL FUNCTIONS ==========
        function openResetModal() {
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('resetPasswordModal'));
            modal.show();
            document.getElementById('newPassword').value = '';
            document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value = '';
            document.getElementById('passwordMatch').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('passwordStrength').style.width = '0%';
            document.getElementById('passwordStrength').style.backgroundColor = '';
            ['reqLength','reqLowercase','reqUppercase','reqNumber','reqSpecial'].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                el.className = 'invalid';
                el.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ' + el.textContent.replace(/[âœ“âœ—]/g, '').trim();
            });
        }

        function openStatusModal() {
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('statusModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // ========== PASSWORD TOGGLE ==========
        function togglePassword(inputId, toggleId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const toggle = document.getElementById(toggleId);
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye';
            }
        }

        // ========== PASSWORD STRENGTH ==========
        function checkPasswordStrength(password) {
            const bar = document.getElementById('passwordStrength');
            let strength = 0;
            const hasLength = password.length >= 6;
            const hasLowercase = /[a-z]/.test(password);
            const hasUppercase = /[A-Z]/.test(password);
            const hasNumber = /[0-9]/.test(password);
            const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(password);

            updateRequirement('reqLength', hasLength);
            updateRequirement('reqLowercase', hasLowercase);
            updateRequirement('reqUppercase', hasUppercase);
            updateRequirement('reqNumber', hasNumber);
            updateRequirement('reqSpecial', hasSpecial);

            if (hasLength) strength++;
            if (hasLowercase) strength++;
            if (hasUppercase) strength++;
            if (hasNumber) strength++;
            if (hasSpecial) strength++;

            if (password.length === 0) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '';
                bar.style.width = '0%';
            } else if (strength <= 2) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#dc3545';
                bar.style.width = '20%';
            } else if (strength === 3) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#ffc107';
                bar.style.width = '50%';
            } else if (strength === 4) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#17a2b8';
                bar.style.width = '75%';
            } else {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745';
                bar.style.width = '100%';
            }
            checkPasswordMatch();
        }

        function updateRequirement(id, isValid) {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            const text = el.textContent.replace(/[âœ“âœ—]/g, '').trim();
            if (isValid) {
                el.className = 'valid';
                el.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> ' + text;
            } else {
                el.className = 'invalid';
                el.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ' + text;
            }
        }

        function checkPasswordMatch() {
            const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPwd = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            const match = document.getElementById('passwordMatch');
            if (confirmPwd.length === 0) {
                match.textContent = '';
                match.className = 'text-muted';
                return;
            }
            if (newPwd === confirmPwd) {
                match.textContent = 'âœ“ Passwords match!';
                match.className = 'text-success';
            } else {
                match.textContent = 'âœ— Passwords do not match';
                match.className = 'text-danger';
            }
        }

        // ========== STATUS CHANGE WARNING ==========
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const statusSelect = document.getElementById('status');
            if (statusSelect) {
                statusSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
                    const warning = document.getElementById('statusChangeWarning');
                    warning.style.display = (this.value !== '<%= driver.status %>') ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            }
            // Auto-dismiss flash messages
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });

        // ========== FORM VALIDATION ==========
        document.getElementById('resetPasswordForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPwd = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            if (!newPwd || !confirmPwd) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Please fill in all fields'); return false; }
            if (newPwd !== confirmPwd) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Passwords do not match!'); return false; }
            if (newPwd.length < 6) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Password must be at least 6 characters'); return false; }
            if (!/[a-z]/.test(newPwd) || !/[A-Z]/.test(newPwd) || !/[0-9]/.test(newPwd) || !/[!@#$%^&*]/.test(newPwd)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Password must contain lowercase, uppercase, number, and special character');
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>

    <script>
        // Calculate age on date of birth change
        document.getElementById('dateOfBirth').addEventListener('change', function() {
            const dob = new Date(this.value);
            if (dob) {
                const today = new Date();
                let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
                const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
                if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.getDate())) {
                    age--;
                }
                document.getElementById('age').value = age;
            }
        });

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Filter appointments
        function filterAppointments(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.appointment-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // View appointment details
        function viewAppointment(id) {
            window.location.href = `/nurse/appointment/${id}`;
        }

        // Update appointment status
        function updateStatus(appointmentId, status) {
            if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to mark this appointment as ${status}?`)) {
                document.getElementById('statusAppointmentId').value = appointmentId;
                document.getElementById('statusValue').value = status;
                document.getElementById('statusForm').submit();
            }
        }

        // Open reschedule modal
        function openRescheduleModal(id, date, time) {
            document.getElementById('rescheduleAppointmentId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('currentDateTime').textContent =
                new Date(date).toLocaleDateString() + ' at ' + time;
            document.getElementById('rescheduleDate').setAttribute('min', new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('rescheduleModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>


        <!-- Socket.IO â€” live updates via page reload -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/socket.io-client@4.7.2/dist/socket.io.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      const socket = io();

      socket.on('connect', () => {
        console.log('âœ… Patient appointments socket connected');
      });

      socket.on('data-updated', (data) => {
        if (data.type === 'appointment') {
          console.log('ðŸ“… Appointment updated, reloading page...');
          window.location.reload();
        }
      });
    </script>
