    <script>
        // ========== COMPOSE FORM ==========
        // Character counters
        document.getElementById('subject').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            document.getElementById('subjectCount').textContent = count + ' / 100 characters';
        });
        document.getElementById('message').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const el = document.getElementById('charCount');
            el.textContent = count + ' / 1000 characters';
            el.className = 'text-muted char-counter ' + (count > 800 ? 'danger' : count > 600 ? 'warning' : 'success');
        });

        // Compose image preview
        function previewComposeImage(event) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function() {
                const output = document.getElementById('previewImg');
                output.src = reader.result;
                document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'block';
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(event.target.files[0]);
        }

        function removeComposeImage() {
            document.getElementById('image').value = '';
            document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('previewImg').src = '#';
        }

        // ========== REPLY MODAL ==========
        // Character counter for reply
        document.getElementById('replyMessage').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const counter = document.getElementById('replyCount');
            counter.textContent = count + ' / 1000 characters';
            counter.style.color = count > 800 ? '#dc3545' : count > 600 ? '#ffc107' : '#6c757d';
        });

        // Reply image preview
        function previewReplyImage(event) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function() {
                const output = document.getElementById('replyPreviewImg');
                output.src = reader.result;
                document.getElementById('replyImagePreview').style.display = 'block';
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(event.target.files[0]);
        }

        function removeReplyImage() {
            document.getElementById('replyImage').value = '';
            document.getElementById('replyImagePreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('replyPreviewImg').src = '#';
        }

        // ========== FILTER ==========
        function filterMessages(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.message-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // ========== IMAGE VIEW ==========
        function viewImage(imageUrl) {
            document.getElementById('fullImage').src = imageUrl;
            document.getElementById('downloadImage').href = imageUrl;
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('imageModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // ========== VIEW MESSAGE (modal) ==========
        function viewMessage(id) {
            fetch(`/nurse/message/${id}`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.success) {
                        const msg = data.message;
                        let html = `
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-person"></i> From:</strong><p>${msg.patientName}</p></div>
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-envelope"></i> Email:</strong><p>${msg.patientEmail}</p></div>
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-telephone"></i> Phone:</strong><p>${msg.patientPhone}</p></div>
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-tag"></i> Subject:</strong><p>${msg.subject}</p></div>
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-calendar"></i> Sent:</strong><p>${new Date(msg.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</p></div>
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-textarea"></i> Message:</strong>
                                <div class="message-content"><p class="mb-0">${msg.message}</p></div>
                            </div>
                        `;

                        // Add patient image if present
                        if (msg.imageUrl) {
                            html += `
                                <div class="mb-3">
                                    <strong><i class="bi bi-image"></i> Attached Image:</strong>
                                    <div class="mt-2">
                                        <img src="${msg.imageUrl}" alt="Attached image" class="modal-image" onclick="viewImage('${msg.imageUrl}')" style="cursor: pointer;">
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            `;
                        }

                        // Add reply if present
                        if (msg.nurseReply) {
                            html += `
                                <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-reply"></i> Your Reply:</strong>
                                    <div class="reply-content"><p class="mb-0">${msg.nurseReply}</p>
                                    <small class="text-muted mt-2 d-block"><i class="bi bi-calendar"></i> Replied on: ${new Date(msg.replyDate).toLocaleString()}</small></div>
                                </div>
                            `;
                            if (msg.nurseReplyImageUrl) {
                                html += `
                                    <div class="mb-3">
                                        <strong><i class="bi bi-image"></i> Reply Attached Image:</strong>
                                        <div class="mt-2">
                                            <img src="${msg.nurseReplyImageUrl}" alt="Reply image" class="modal-image" onclick="viewImage('${msg.nurseReplyImageUrl}')" style="cursor: pointer;">
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                `;
                            }
                        }

                        html += `
                            <div class="mb-3"><strong><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> Status:</strong>
                                <span class="status-badge status-${msg.status}">
                                    <i class="bi bi-${msg.status === 'unread' ? 'envelope' : msg.status === 'read' ? 'envelope-open' : 'reply-all'}"></i>
                                    ${msg.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + msg.status.slice(1)}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        `;

                        document.getElementById('viewMessageContent').innerHTML = html;
                        document.getElementById('replyFromViewBtn').dataset.messageId = id;
                        const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('viewMessageModal'));
                        modal.show();
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    alert('Failed to load message details');
                });
        }

        // ========== REPLY FROM VIEW ==========
        function replyFromView() {
            const messageId = document.getElementById('replyFromViewBtn').dataset.messageId;
            if (messageId) {
                document.getElementById('viewMessageModal').querySelector('.btn-close').click();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    fetch(`/nurse/message/${messageId}`)
                        .then(response => response.json())
                        .then(data => {
                            if (data.success) {
                                openReplyModal(messageId, data.message.patientName);
                            }
                        });
                }, 300);
            }
        }

        // ========== OPEN REPLY MODAL ==========
        function openReplyModal(id, patientName) {
            document.getElementById('replyMessageId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('replyPatientName').value = patientName;
            document.getElementById('replyMessage').value = '';
            document.getElementById('replyCount').textContent = '0 / 1000 characters';
            document.getElementById('replyImage').value = '';
            document.getElementById('replyImagePreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('replyPreviewImg').src = '#';
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('replyModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // ========== AUTO-DISMISS FLASH MESSAGES ==========
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

      console.log('ðŸ“© New message, reloading page...');
      window.location.reload();
    }
  });

    <script>
        // Character counter for notes
        document.getElementById('notes').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const el = document.getElementById('notesCount');
            el.textContent = count + ' / 500 characters';
            el.style.color = count > 400 ? '#dc3545' : count > 300 ? '#ffc107' : '#6c757d';
        });

        // Photo preview
        function previewPhoto(event) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function() { const output = document.getElementById('previewImg'); output.src = reader.result; document.getElementById('photoPreview').style.display = 'block'; };
            reader.readAsDataURL(event.target.files[0]);
        }
        function removePhoto() {
            document.getElementById('prescriptionPhoto').value = '';
            document.getElementById('photoPreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('previewImg').src = '#';
        }

        // Populate patient details
        function populatePatientDetails() {
            const select = document.getElementById('patientId');
            const selectedOption = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
            if (selectedOption && selectedOption.value) {
                const parts = selectedOption.text.split(' - ');
                const name = parts[0] || '';
                const email = parts[1] || '';
                const phone = parts[2] ? parts[2].replace(/[()]/g, '').trim() : '';
                document.getElementById('patientName').value = name;
                document.getElementById('patientEmail').value = email;
                document.getElementById('patientPhone').value = phone;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('patientName').value = '';
                document.getElementById('patientEmail').value = '';
                document.getElementById('patientPhone').value = '';
            }
        }

        // Get location
        function getLocation() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('locationStatus');
            statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-spinner bi-spin"></i> Getting your location...';
            statusEl.style.color = '#17a2b8';
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude, lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        document.getElementById('latitude').value = lat;
                        document.getElementById('longitude').value = lng;
                        fetch(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=json&lat=${lat}&lon=${lng}`)
                            .then(response => response.json())
                            .then(data => {
                                const address = data.display_name || 'Location found';
                                document.getElementById('location').value = address;
                                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle text-success"></i> Location captured successfully!';
                                statusEl.style.color = '#28a745';
                            })
                            .catch(() => {
                                document.getElementById('location').value = `Lat: ${lat}, Lng: ${lng}`;
                                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle text-success"></i> Location captured (coordinates)';
                                statusEl.style.color = '#28a745';
                            });
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        let errorMsg = 'Unable to get location. ';
                        switch(error.code) {
                            case error.PERMISSION_DENIED: errorMsg += 'Please allow location access.'; break;
                            case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: errorMsg += 'Location information is unavailable.'; break;
                            case error.TIMEOUT: errorMsg += 'The request timed out.'; break;
                            default: errorMsg += 'Please enter your address manually.';
                        }
                        statusEl.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle text-danger"></i> ${errorMsg}`;
                        statusEl.style.color = '#dc3545';
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            } else {
                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle text-danger"></i> Geolocation is not supported. Please enter address manually.';
                statusEl.style.color = '#dc3545';
            }
        }

        // Filter orders
        function filterOrders(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.order-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => { card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none'; });
        }

        // View order
        function viewOrder(id) { window.location.href = `/nurse/order/${id}`; }

        // View prescription image
        function viewPrescriptionImage(imageUrl) {
            document.getElementById('prescriptionModalImage').src = imageUrl;
            document.getElementById('downloadPrescriptionBtn').href = imageUrl;
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('prescriptionModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // Assign driver modal
        function openAssignDriverModal(id, patientName, location, lat, lng) {
            document.getElementById('assignOrderId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('assignPatientName').value = patientName || 'Patient';
            document.getElementById('assignLocation').value = location || 'Location not provided';
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('assignDriverModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // Update order status
        function updateOrderStatus(orderId, status) {
            document.getElementById('statusOrderId').value = orderId;
            document.getElementById('statusValue').value = status;
            document.getElementById('statusForm').submit();
        }
        function markDelivered(orderId) {
            if (confirm('Mark this order as delivered?')) updateOrderStatus(orderId, 'delivered');
        }
        function cancelOrder(orderId) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this order?')) updateOrderStatus(orderId, 'cancelled');
        }

        // Switch tab
        function switchTab(tabId) {
            const tabTrigger = document.querySelector(`#orderTabs button[data-bs-target="#${tabId}"]`);
            if (tabTrigger) { const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(tabTrigger); tab.show(); }
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => { a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease'; a.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500); }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Search patients
        function searchPatients() {
            const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
            const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
            document.querySelectorAll('.patient-card').forEach(card => {
                const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
                card.style.display = text.includes(filter) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // View patient details (with tabs)
        function viewPatient(id) {
            fetch(`/nurse/patient/${id}`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.success) {
                        const p = data.patient;
                        const profile = data.profile || {};
                        const appointments = data.appointments || [];
                        const messages = data.messages || [];
                        const orders = data.orders || [];

                        // Store patient id for "Set Chronic" button
                        document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal').setAttribute('data-patient-id', id);
                        document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal').setAttribute('data-patient-name', p.name);
                        document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal').setAttribute('data-medication-name', profile.medicationName || '');
                        document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal').setAttribute('data-refill-interval', profile.refillIntervalDays || '');
                        document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal').setAttribute('data-is-chronic', profile.isChronic ? 'true' : 'false');

                        document.getElementById('patientModalBody').innerHTML = `
                            <div class="row">
                                <div class="col-md-4">
                                    <div class="card p-3">
                                        <h6><i class="bi bi-person-badge"></i> Profile Information</h6>
                                        <hr>
                                        <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Name:</span><span class="info-value">${p.name}</span></div>
                                        <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Email:</span><span class="info-value">${p.email}</span></div>
                                        <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Role:</span><span class="info-value"><span class="badge bg-primary">${p.role}</span></span></div>
                                        <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Status:</span><span class="info-value"><span class="status-badge ${p.isVerified ? 'status-active' : 'status-pending'}">${p.isVerified ? 'Verified' : 'Unverified'}</span></span></div>
                                        <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Joined:</span><span class="info-value">${new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span></div>
                                        ${profile.idNumber ? `<div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">ID Number:</span><span class="info-value">${profile.idNumber}</span></div>` : ''}
                                        ${profile.phone ? `<div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Phone:</span><span class="info-value">${profile.phone}</span></div>` : ''}
                                        ${profile.dateOfBirth ? `<div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Date of Birth:</span><span class="info-value">${new Date(profile.dateOfBirth).toLocaleDateString()}</span></div>` : ''}
                                        ${profile.isChronic ? `<div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Chronic:</span><span class="info-value"><span class="badge chronic-badge">Yes</span></span></div><div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Medication:</span><span class="info-value">${profile.medicationName || 'N/A'}</span></div><div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Next Refill:</span><span class="info-value">${profile.nextRefillDate ? new Date(profile.nextRefillDate).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A'}</span></div>` : ''}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="col-md-8">
                                    <ul class="nav nav-tabs" id="patientTab" role="tablist">
                                        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link active" id="appointments-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#appointments">Appointments (${appointments.length})</a></li>
                                        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" id="messages-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#messages">Messages (${messages.length})</a></li>
                                        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link" id="orders-tab" data-bs-toggle="tab" href="#orders">Orders (${orders.length})</a></li>
                                    </ul>
                                    <div class="tab-content">
                                        <div class="tab-pane fade show active" id="appointments">
                                            ${appointments.length > 0 ? appointments.map(appt => `
                                                <div class="detail-card">
                                                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                                                        <div><strong>${new Date(appt.date).toLocaleDateString()}</strong> at ${appt.time}<br><small class="text-muted">${appt.description}</small></div>
                                                        <span class="status-badge status-${appt.status}">${appt.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + appt.status.slice(1)}</span>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            `).join('') : `<div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-calendar-x"></i><p>No appointments found</p></div>`}
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="tab-pane fade" id="messages">
                                            ${messages.length > 0 ? messages.map(msg => `
                                                <div class="detail-card">
                                                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                                                        <div><strong>${msg.subject}</strong><br><small class="text-muted">${msg.message.substring(0, 80)}${msg.message.length > 80 ? 'â€¦' : ''}</small></div>
                                                        <span class="status-badge status-${msg.status}">${msg.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + msg.status.slice(1)}</span>
                                                    </div>
                                                    ${msg.nurseReply ? `<div class="mt-2"><small class="text-success"><i class="bi bi-reply"></i> Reply: ${msg.nurseReply.substring(0, 60)}${msg.nurseReply.length > 60 ? 'â€¦' : ''}</small></div>` : ''}
                                                </div>
                                            `).join('') : `<div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-envelope-x"></i><p>No messages found</p></div>`}
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="tab-pane fade" id="orders">
                                            ${orders.length > 0 ? orders.map(order => `
                                                <div class="detail-card">
                                                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
                                                        <div><strong>${order.prescriptionName}</strong><br><small class="text-muted">${order.location}</small></div>
                                                        <span class="status-badge status-${order.status}">${order.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + order.status.slice(1)}</span>
                                                    </div>
                                                    ${order.notes ? `<div class="mt-2"><small class="text-muted"><i class="bi bi-chat"></i> ${order.notes}</small></div>` : ''}
                                                </div>
                                            `).join('') : `<div class="empty-state"><i class="bi bi-prescription"></i><p>No orders found</p></div>`}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                        const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('patientModal'));
                        modal.show();
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    alert('Failed to load patient details');
                });
        }

        // Set chronic from patient modal
        function setChronicFromModal() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('setChronicFromModal');
            const patientId = btn.getAttribute('data-patient-id');
            const patientName = btn.getAttribute('data-patient-name');
            const medicationName = btn.getAttribute('data-medication-name');
            const refillInterval = btn.getAttribute('data-refill-interval');
            const isChronic = btn.getAttribute('data-is-chronic');
            // Close patient modal
            bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('patientModal')).hide();
            // Open chronic modal
            openChronicModal(patientId, patientName, medicationName, refillInterval, isChronic);
        }

        // Open Chronic Modal
        function openChronicModal(patientId, patientName, medicationName, refillInterval, isChronic) {
            document.getElementById('chronicForm').action = `/nurse/patient/chronic/${patientId}`;
            document.getElementById('chronicPatientId').value = patientId;
            document.getElementById('chronicPatientName').value = patientName;
            document.getElementById('isChronic').checked = (isChronic === 'true');
            document.getElementById('medicationName').value = medicationName || '';
            document.getElementById('refillIntervalDays').value = refillInterval || '';
            document.getElementById('startTimer').checked = false;
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('chronicModal'));
            modal.show();
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => { a.style.opacity = '0'; a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s'; setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500); }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // Autoâ€‘dismiss flash messages
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });

            // Calculate age on load
            const dob = document.getElementById('dateOfBirth').value;
            if (dob) {
                const dobDate = new Date(dob);
                const today = new Date();
                let age = today.getFullYear() - dobDate.getFullYear();
                const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dobDate.getMonth();
                if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dobDate.getDate())) age--;
                document.getElementById('age').value = age;
            }

            // Make inputs readonly initially
            document.querySelectorAll('#profileForm input').forEach(input => {
                input.setAttribute('readonly', true);
                input.style.backgroundColor = '#e9ecef';
                input.style.cursor = 'default';
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('dateOfBirth').addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (!this.readOnly) {
                const dob = new Date(this.value);
                if (dob) {
                    const today = new Date();
                    let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
                    const monthDiff = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
                    if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.getDate())) age--;
                    document.getElementById('age').value = age;
                }
            }
        });

        function enableEdit() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#profileForm input').forEach(input => {
                if (input.id !== 'age') {
                    input.removeAttribute('readonly');
                    input.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
                    input.style.cursor = 'text';
                }
            });
            document.getElementById('editBtn').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('saveBtn').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('cancelBtn').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('resetBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
            document.getElementById('submitBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
            document.querySelector('.card.p-4 h4').innerHTML =
                '<i class="bi bi-person-vcard"></i> Professional Information <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark ms-2">Editing Mode</span>';
            document.getElementById('name').focus();
        }

        function saveProfile() {
            document.getElementById('profileForm').submit();
        }

        function cancelEdit() {
            location.reload();
        }
    </script>

        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="alert alert-info d-flex align-items-center">

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <%- include('../partials/flash') %>

        <div class="row g-4">
            <div class="col-12 col-lg-8">
                <div class="card p-3">
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3 flex-wrap">
                        <h6 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-map"></i> Live Map</h6>
                        <div>
                            <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm me-2" onclick="fitAllMarkers()">
                                <i class="bi bi-arrows-expand"></i> Zoom to All
                            </button>

                                <i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i> Reset View
                            </button>
                        </div>

                    <div id="map"></div>
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-start align-items-center flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2">
                        <span class="badge bg-danger"><i class="bi bi-circle-fill"></i> Online</span>
                        <span class="badge bg-secondary"><i class="bi bi-circle-fill"></i> Offline</span>

                    </div>
                    <small class="text-muted mt-2 d-block" id="lastUpdateTime">Last update: --</small>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="col-12 col-lg-4">

                    <h6 class="mb-3"><i class="bi bi-people"></i> All Drivers</h6>
                    <div id="driverList">
                        <div class="text-center text-muted py-5">

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/socket.io-client@4.7.2/dist/socket.io.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        // ========== SOCKET ==========
        const socket = io();

        // ========== MAP STATE ==========
        let map;
        let markers = {};
        let selectedDriverId = null;
        let driversData = [];
        let useOfflineTiles = false;

        // ========== MARKER ICONS ==========
        // Online â€” solid red dot with pulsing glow
        const activeDriverIcon = L.divIcon({
            html: `
              <div style="position:relative;width:24px;height:24px;">
                <div style="position:absolute;inset:0;background:#dc3545;border-radius:50%;
                            border:3px solid white;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.5);
                            animation:pulseDot 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;"></div>
              </div>
              <style>
                @keyframes pulseDot {
                  0%,100% { transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.5); }
                  50%     { transform:scale(1.15); box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.9); }
                }
              </style>
            `,
            iconSize: [24, 24],
            iconAnchor: [12, 12],
            popupAnchor: [0, -14],
            className: 'red-dot-marker-online'
        });

        // Offline â€” muted red dot (no pulse)
        const driverIcon = L.divIcon({
            html: `<div style="width:18px;height:18px;background:#dc3545;opacity:0.55;
                            border-radius:50%;border:3px solid white;
                            box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);"></div>`,
            iconSize: [18, 18],
            iconAnchor: [9, 9],
            popupAnchor: [0, -12],
            className: 'red-dot-marker-offline'
        });

        // On Leave â€” yellow dot
        const onLeaveIcon = L.divIcon({
            html: `<div style="width:20px;height:20px;background:#ffc107;
                            border-radius:50%;border:3px solid white;
                            box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(255,193,7,0.4);"></div>`,
            iconSize: [20, 20],
            iconAnchor: [10, 10],
            popupAnchor: [0, -12],
            className: 'yellow-dot-marker'
        });

        // ========== INIT MAP ==========
        function initMap() {
            fetch('/api/tiles/status')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    useOfflineTiles = data.available;
                    console.log(`ðŸ—ºï¸ Using ${useOfflineTiles ? 'offline' : 'online'} tiles`);
                    setupMap();
                })
                .catch(() => {
                    useOfflineTiles = false;
                    setupMap();
                });
        }

        function setupMap() {
            const tileUrl = useOfflineTiles
                ? '/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png'
                : 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';

            map = L.map('map').setView([-22.5609, 17.0658], 12);

            L.tileLayer(tileUrl, {
                maxZoom: 19,
                attribution: 'Â© OpenStreetMap contributors',
                errorTileUrl: 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8//8/AwAI/AL+fH5B4AAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='
            }).addTo(map);

            socket.emit('get-active-drivers');
        }

        // ========== UPDATE DRIVER LIST ==========
        function updateDriverList(drivers) {
            driversData = drivers;
            const listEl = document.getElementById('driverList');

            if (!drivers || drivers.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-muted py-4"><i class="bi bi-truck"></i><p>No drivers registered</p></div>`;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            drivers.forEach(d => {
                const status = determineStatus(d);
                const statusText = status === 'online' ? 'Online' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'On Leave' : 'Offline';
                const statusClass = status === 'online' ? 'online' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'on-leave' : 'offline';
                const statusBadgeClass = status === 'online' ? 'status-badge-online' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'status-badge-on-leave' : 'status-badge-offline';
                const statusIndicatorClass = status === 'online' ? 'status-online' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'status-on-leave' : 'status-offline';

                const lastUpdate = d.lastUpdate ? new Date(d.lastUpdate).toLocaleTimeString() : 'Never';
                const phone = d.driverPhone || 'N/A';
                const name = d.driverName || 'Unknown';

                html += `
                    <div class="driver-list-item ${statusClass}" data-driver-id="${d.driverId}" onclick="selectDriver('${d.driverId}')">
                        <span class="driver-status-indicator ${statusIndicatorClass}"></span>
                        <div class="driver-info">
                            <div class="driver-name"><i class="bi bi-person"></i> ${name}</div>
                            <div class="driver-phone"><i class="bi bi-telephone"></i> ${phone}</div>
                            <div class="driver-last-update"><i class="bi bi-clock"></i> Last: ${lastUpdate}</div>
                        </div>
                        <span class="driver-status-badge ${statusBadgeClass}">${statusText}</span>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            listEl.innerHTML = html;
            document.getElementById('lastUpdateTime').textContent = `Last update: ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`;
        }

        // ========== DETERMINE STATUS ==========
        function determineStatus(d) {
            if (d.status === 'on-leave') return 'on-leave';
            if (d.online) return 'online';
            return 'offline';
        }

        // ========== MARKER UPDATES ==========
        function updateMarker(driver) {
            const { driverId, driverName, latitude, longitude, online, status } = driver;

            if (!latitude || !longitude) {
                if (markers[driverId]) {
                    map.removeLayer(markers[driverId]);
                    delete markers[driverId];
                }
                return;
            }

            const latlng = [latitude, longitude];
            let icon;
            if (status === 'on-leave') icon = onLeaveIcon;
            else if (online) icon = activeDriverIcon;
            else icon = driverIcon;

            if (markers[driverId]) {
                moveMarkerSmoothly(markers[driverId], latitude, longitude, 450);
                markers[driverId].setIcon(icon);
                markers[driverId].bindPopup(createPopupContent(driver));
            } else {
                const marker = L.marker(latlng, { icon: icon }).addTo(map);
                marker.bindPopup(createPopupContent(driver));
                markers[driverId] = marker;
            }
        }

        // ========== SMOOTH MARKER ANIMATION ==========
        function moveMarkerSmoothly(marker, newLat, newLng, duration) {
            duration = duration || 450;
            const start = marker.getLatLng();
            const end = L.latLng(newLat, newLng);
            const startTime = performance.now();

            if (start.distanceTo(end) < 1) {
                marker.setLatLng(end);
                return;
            }

            function step(now) {
                const t = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
                const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
                const lat = start.lat + (end.lat - start.lat) * eased;
                const lng = start.lng + (end.lng - start.lng) * eased;
                marker.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
                if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }

        function createPopupContent(driver) {
            const status = determineStatus(driver);
            const statusText = status === 'online' ? 'Online' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'On Leave' : 'Offline';
            const statusColor = status === 'online' ? '#dc3545' : status === 'on-leave' ? '#ffc107' : '#6c757d';
            return `
                <strong>${driver.driverName || 'Unknown'}</strong> ${status === 'online' ? 'ðŸ”´' : status === 'on-leave' ? 'ðŸŸ¡' : 'âš«'}<br>
                <i class="bi bi-telephone"></i> ${driver.driverPhone || 'N/A'}<br>
                <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> ${driver.latitude.toFixed(6)}, ${driver.longitude.toFixed(6)}<br>
                <i class="bi bi-clock"></i> ${new Date(driver.lastUpdate || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString()}<br>
                <span style="color:${statusColor};font-weight:600;">${statusText}</span>
            `;
        }

        // ========== SELECT DRIVER ==========
        function selectDriver(driverId) {
            selectedDriverId = driverId;
            const marker = markers[driverId];
            if (marker) {
                map.setView(marker.getLatLng(), 16);
                marker.openPopup();
            }
            document.querySelectorAll('.driver-list-item').forEach(el => {
                el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.driverId === driverId);
            });
        }

        // ========== ZOOM TO ALL ==========
        function fitAllMarkers() {
            const ids = Object.keys(markers);
            if (ids.length === 0) return;
            const group = L.featureGroup(Object.values(markers));
            map.fitBounds(group.getBounds().pad(0.2));
        }

        // ========== RESET MAP VIEW ==========
        function resetMapView() {
            map.setView([-22.5609, 17.0658], 12);
        }

        // ========== SOCKET EVENTS ==========
        socket.on('active-drivers-list', (drivers) => {
            console.log('ðŸ“‹ All drivers:', drivers);
            drivers.forEach(driver => updateMarker(driver));
            updateDriverList(drivers);
        });

        socket.on('driver-location-update', (data) => {
            console.log('ðŸ“ Location update:', data);
            updateMarker(data);
            socket.emit('get-active-drivers');
        });

        socket.on('driver-disconnected', (data) => {
            console.log('ðŸ”´ Driver disconnected:', data.driverId);
            socket.emit('get-active-drivers');
        });

        socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
            console.error('âŒ Socket connection error:', err);
            document.getElementById('driverList').innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-danger py-3"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i><p>Connection error. Please refresh.</p></div>`;
        });

        // Fallback refresh every 30 seconds
        setInterval(() => {
            socket.emit('get-active-drivers');
        }, 30000);

        // ========== INIT ==========
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            initMap();
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Character counter
        const description = document.getElementById('description');
        const charCount = document.getElementById('charCount');
        if (description) {
            description.addEventListener('input', function() {
                const count = this.value.length;
                charCount.textContent = count + ' / 500 characters';
                charCount.style.color = count > 400 ? '#dc3545' : count > 300 ? '#ffc107' : '#6c757d';
            });
        }

        // Switch to Details tab (from empty state)
        function switchToDetailsTab() {
            const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(document.getElementById('details-tab'));
            tab.show();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Form validation
        const appointmentForm = document.getElementById('appointmentForm');
        if (appointmentForm) {
            appointmentForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                const phone = document.getElementById('patientPhone').value;
                const date = document.getElementById('date').value;
                const time = document.getElementById('time').value;
                const desc = document.getElementById('description').value.trim();

                if (!phone.match(/^[0-9+\-\s()]{10,15}$/)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    alert('Please enter a valid phone number');
                    return false;
                }
                if (!date) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    alert('Please select a date');
                    return false;
                }
                if (!time) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    alert('Please select a time slot');
                    return false;
                }
                if (!desc || desc.length < 10) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    alert('Please provide a description (minimum 10 characters)');
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            });
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert:not(.alert-info):not(.warning-highlight)').forEach(function(a) {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(function() { a.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Toggle password visibility
        function togglePassword(inputId, toggleId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const toggle = document.getElementById(toggleId);
            if (input.type === 'password') {
                input.type = 'text';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye-slash';
            } else {
                input.type = 'password';
                toggle.className = 'bi bi-eye';
            }
        }

        // Validate new password
        function validateNewPassword(password) {
            const hasLength = password.length >= 6;
            const hasLowercase = /[a-z]/.test(password);
            const hasUppercase = /[A-Z]/.test(password);
            const hasNumber = /[0-9]/.test(password);
            const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(password);

            updateRequirement('reqLength', hasLength);
            updateRequirement('reqLowercase', hasLowercase);
            updateRequirement('reqUppercase', hasUppercase);
            updateRequirement('reqNumber', hasNumber);
            updateRequirement('reqSpecial', hasSpecial);

            updatePasswordStrength(password);
            checkPasswordMatch();
            updateValidationSummary();
        }

        function updateRequirement(id, isValid) {
            const element = document.getElementById(id);
            const text = element.textContent.replace(/[âœ“âœ—]/g, '').trim();
            if (isValid) {
                element.className = 'valid';
                element.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> ' + text;
            } else {
                element.className = 'invalid';
                element.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ' + text;
            }
        }

        function updatePasswordStrength(password) {
            const bar = document.getElementById('passwordStrength');
            let strength = 0;
            if (password.length >= 6) strength++;
            if (/[a-z]/.test(password)) strength++;
            if (/[A-Z]/.test(password)) strength++;
            if (/[0-9]/.test(password)) strength++;
            if (/[!@#$%^&*]/.test(password)) strength++;
            if (password.length === 0) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '';
                bar.style.width = '0%';
            } else if (strength <= 2) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#dc3545';
                bar.style.width = '20%';
            } else if (strength === 3) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#ffc107';
                bar.style.width = '50%';
            } else if (strength === 4) {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#17a2b8';
                bar.style.width = '75%';
            } else {
                bar.style.backgroundColor = '#28a745';
                bar.style.width = '100%';
            }
        }

        function checkPasswordMatch() {
            const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirmPwd = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            const match = document.getElementById('passwordMatch');
            if (confirmPwd.length === 0) {
                match.textContent = '';
                match.className = 'text-muted';
                return;
            }
            if (newPwd === confirmPwd) {
                match.textContent = 'âœ“ Passwords match!';
                match.className = 'text-success';
            } else {
                match.textContent = 'âœ— Passwords do not match';
                match.className = 'text-danger';
            }
        }

        function updateValidationSummary() {
            const summary = document.getElementById('validationSummary');
            const list = document.getElementById('validationList');
            const errors = [];
            const current = document.getElementById('currentPassword').value;
            if (!current) errors.push('Current password is required');
            const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            if (!newPwd) {
                errors.push('New password is required');
            } else {
                if (newPwd.length < 6) errors.push('Password must be at least 6 characters');
                if (!/[a-z]/.test(newPwd)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
                if (!/[A-Z]/.test(newPwd)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
                if (!/[0-9]/.test(newPwd)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
                if (!/[!@#$%^&*]/.test(newPwd)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character (!@#$%^&*)');
            }
            const confirm = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            if (!confirm) errors.push('Confirm password is required');
            else if (newPwd && newPwd !== confirm) errors.push('Passwords do not match');

            if (errors.length > 0) {
                summary.className = 'validation-summary show';
                list.innerHTML = errors.map(e => `<li>â€¢ ${e}</li>`).join('');
            } else {
                summary.className = 'validation-summary';
                list.innerHTML = '';
            }
        }

        function validateForm() {
            const current = document.getElementById('currentPassword').value;
            const newPwd = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
            const confirm = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;
            if (!current || !newPwd || !confirm) {
                alert('Please fill in all fields');
                return false;
            }
            const hasLength = newPwd.length >= 6;
            const hasLower = /[a-z]/.test(newPwd);
            const hasUpper = /[A-Z]/.test(newPwd);
            const hasNum = /[0-9]/.test(newPwd);
            const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(newPwd);
            if (!hasLength || !hasLower || !hasUpper || !hasNum || !hasSpecial) {
                alert('Password must meet all requirements:\n- At least 6 characters\n- Lowercase, uppercase, number, and special character');
                return false;
            }
            if (newPwd !== confirm) {
                alert('New password and confirm password do not match');
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
            ['currentPassword', 'newPassword', 'confirmPassword'].forEach(id => {
                document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input', updateValidationSummary);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>

    <script>
        // Character counters
        document.getElementById('subject').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            document.getElementById('subjectCount').textContent = count + ' / 100 characters';
        });
        document.getElementById('message').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const el = document.getElementById('charCount');
            el.textContent = count + ' / 1000 characters';
            el.className = 'text-muted char-counter ' + (count > 800 ? 'danger' : count > 600 ? 'warning' : 'success');
        });

        // Image preview
        function previewImage(event) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function() {
                const output = document.getElementById('previewImg');
                output.src = reader.result;
                document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'block';
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(event.target.files[0]);
        }

        function removeImage() {
            document.getElementById('image').value = '';
            document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('previewImg').src = '#';
        }

        // Filter messages
        function filterMessages(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.message-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // View, edit, delete
        function viewMessage(id) { window.location.href = `/patient/message/${id}`; }
        function editMessage(id) { window.location.href = `/patient/message/edit/${id}`; }
        function deleteMessage(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this message?')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/patient/message/delete/${id}`;
                // CSRF token embedded directly from EJS
                var _csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                _csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                _csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                _csrfInput.value = '<%= csrfToken %>';
                form.appendChild(_csrfInput);
                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Switch tabs
        function switchTab(tabId) {
            const tabTrigger = document.querySelector(`#messageTabs button[data-bs-target="#${tabId}"]`);
            if (tabTrigger) {
                const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(tabTrigger);
                tab.show();
            }
        }

        // Auto-switch to 'Create' tab when replying
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const parentId = '<%= parentId || "" %>';
            const replySubject = '<%= replySubject || "" %>';
            if (parentId || replySubject) {
                switchTab('create');
                // Focus on message textarea after a short delay
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const msgField = document.getElementById('message');
                    if (msgField) msgField.focus();
                }, 300);
            }

            // Auto-dismiss flash messages
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });

            // Form validation
            document.getElementById('composeForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                const phone = document.getElementById('patientPhone').value;
                const subject = document.getElementById('subject').value.trim();
                const msg = document.getElementById('message').value.trim();
                if (!phone.match(/^[0-9+\-\s()]{10,15}$/)) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Please enter a valid phone number'); return; }
                if (subject.length < 3) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Subject must be at least 3 characters'); return; }
                if (msg.length < 10) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Message must be at least 10 characters'); return; }
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    if (data.type === 'message') {
      console.log('ðŸ“© New message, reloading page...');
      window.location.reload();
    }
  });

    <script>
        // Delete message
        function deleteMessage(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this message? This action cannot be undone.')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/patient/message/delete/${id}`;
                // CSRF token embedded directly from EJS
                var _csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                _csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                _csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                _csrfInput.value = '<%= csrfToken %>';
                form.appendChild(_csrfInput);
                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Autoâ€‘dismiss flash messages (if any)
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

        document.getElementById('subject').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const counter = document.getElementById('subjectCount');
            counter.textContent = count + ' / 100 characters';
            if (count > 80) {
                counter.style.color = '#dc3545';
            } else if (count > 60) {
                counter.style.color = '#ffc107';
            } else {
                counter.style.color = '#6c757d';
            }
        });

        // Character counter for message
        document.getElementById('message').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const count = this.value.length;
            const counter = document.getElementById('charCount');
            counter.textContent = count + ' / 1000 characters';
            if (count > 800) {
                counter.className = 'text-muted char-counter danger';
            } else if (count > 600) {
                counter.className = 'text-muted char-counter warning';
            } else {
                counter.className = 'text-muted char-counter success';
            }
        });

        // Image preview
        function previewImage(event) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function() {
                const output = document.getElementById('previewImg');
                output.src = reader.result;
                document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'block';
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(event.target.files[0]);
        }

        function removeImage() {
            document.getElementById('image').value = '';
            document.getElementById('imagePreview').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('previewImg').src = '#';
        }

        // Form validation
        document.getElementById('editMessageForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            const subject = document.getElementById('subject').value.trim();
            const message = document.getElementById('message').value.trim();
            if (!subject || subject.length < 3) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Please enter a subject (minimum 3 characters)');
                return false;
            }
            if (!message || message.length < 10) {
                e.preventDefault();
                alert('Please enter a message (minimum 10 characters)');
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        // Autoâ€‘dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Character counter for notes
        const notesEl = document.getElementById('notes');
        if (notesEl) {
            notesEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
                const count = this.value.length;
                const el = document.getElementById('notesCount');
                el.textContent = count + ' / 500 characters';
                el.style.color = count > 400 ? '#dc3545' : count > 300 ? '#ffc107' : '#6c757d';
            });

        // Get current location
        function getLocation() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('locationStatus');
            statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-spinner bi-spin"></i> Getting your location...';
            statusEl.style.color = '#17a2b8';

            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                    function(position) {
                        const lat = position.coords.latitude;
                        const lng = position.coords.longitude;
                        document.getElementById('latitude').value = lat;
                        document.getElementById('longitude').value = lng;

                        fetch(`https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse?format=json&lat=${lat}&lon=${lng}`)
                            .then(response => response.json())
                            .then(data => {
                                const address = data.display_name || 'Location found';
                                document.getElementById('location').value = address;
                                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle text-success"></i> Location captured successfully!';
                                statusEl.style.color = '#28a745';
                            })
                            .catch(() => {
                                document.getElementById('location').value = `Lat: ${lat}, Lng: ${lng}`;
                                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle text-success"></i> Location captured (coordinates)';
                                statusEl.style.color = '#28a745';
                            });
                    },
                    function(error) {
                        let errorMsg = 'Unable to get location. ';
                        switch(error.code) {
                            case error.PERMISSION_DENIED: errorMsg += 'Please allow location access.';
                                break;
                            case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE: errorMsg += 'Location information is unavailable.';
                                break;
                            case error.TIMEOUT: errorMsg += 'The request timed out.';
                                break;
                            default: errorMsg += 'Please enter your address manually.';
                        }
                        statusEl.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle text-danger"></i> ${errorMsg}`;
                        statusEl.style.color = '#dc3545';
                    },
                    { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0 }
                );
            } else {
                statusEl.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle text-danger"></i> Geolocation is not supported. Please enter address manually.';
                statusEl.style.color = '#dc3545';
            }
        }

        // View order details
        function viewOrder(id) {
            window.location.href = `/patient/order/${id}`;
        }

        // Cancel order
        function cancelOrder(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this order?')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/patient/order/cancel/${id}`;
                // CSRF token embedded directly from EJS
                var _csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                _csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                _csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                _csrfInput.value = '<%= csrfToken %>';
                form.appendChild(_csrfInput);
                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Switch to Place Order tab
        function switchToPlaceTab() {
            const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(document.getElementById('place-tab'));
            tab.show();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Form validation
        const orderForm = document.getElementById('orderForm');
        if (orderForm) {
            orderForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
                const phone = document.getElementById('patientPhone').value;
                const prescription = document.getElementById('prescriptionName').value.trim();
                const location = document.getElementById('location').value.trim();
                if (!phone.match(/^[0-9+\-\s()]{10,15}$/)) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Please enter a valid phone number'); return; }
                if (prescription.length < 3) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Prescription name must be at least 3 characters'); return; }
                if (location.length < 5) { e.preventDefault(); alert('Please enter a valid delivery location'); return; }
            });
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages ONLY, NOT the chronic card
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert:not(.chronic-card):not(.alert-light)').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Socket.IO real-time order updates -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/socket.io-client@4.7.2/dist/socket.io.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        const socket = io();

        socket.on('connect', () => {
            console.log('âœ… Patient order socket connected');
        });

        socket.on('data-updated', (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'order') {
                console.log('ðŸ“¦ Order updated, reloading page...');
                window.location.reload();
            }
        });
    </script>

</body>

    <script>
        // View prescription image
        function viewPrescription(imageUrl) {
            const container = document.getElementById('prescriptionContainer');
            const img = document.getElementById('prescriptionImage');
            if (container.style.display === 'none') {
                container.style.display = 'block';
                container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
            } else {
                container.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
        function closePrescription() {
            document.getElementById('prescriptionContainer').style.display = 'none';
        }

        // Cancel order
        function cancelOrder(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this order? This action cannot be undone.')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/patient/order/cancel/${id}`;
                // CSRF token embedded directly from EJS
                var _csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                _csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                _csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                _csrfInput.value = '<%= csrfToken %>';
                form.appendChild(_csrfInput);
                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

        // Tab switch helper
        function switchTab(tabId) {
            const tab = new bootstrap.Tab(document.getElementById(tabId));
            tab.show();
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Form validation
        const editForm = document.getElementById('editProfileForm');
        if (editForm) {
            editForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
                const phone = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();
                if (!phone || !phone.match(/^[0-9+\-\s()]{10,15}$/)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    alert('Please enter a valid phone number (10-15 digits)');
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            });
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(function (a) {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(function () { a.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Filter appointments by status
        function filterAppointments(status) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.appointment-card');
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === status));
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (status === 'all' || card.dataset.status === status) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        // View appointment details
        function viewAppointment(id) {
            window.location.href = `/patient/appointment/${id}`;
        }

        // Cancel appointment (POST form)
        function cancelAppointment(id) {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment?')) {
                const form = document.createElement('form');
                form.method = 'POST';
                form.action = `/patient/appointment/cancel/${id}`;
                // CSRF token embedded directly from EJS
                var _csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
                _csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
                _csrfInput.name = '_csrf';
                _csrfInput.value = '<%= csrfToken %>';
                form.appendChild(_csrfInput);
                document.body.appendChild(form);
                form.submit();
            }
        }

        // Auto-dismiss flash messages
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.alert').forEach(a => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    a.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
                    a.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => a.style.display = 'none', 500);
                }, 5000);
            });
        });

        // ========== SOCKET.IO â€” LIVE UPDATES ==========
        const socket = io();

        socket.on('connect', () => {
            console.log('âœ… Patient appointments socket connected');
        });

        socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
            console.error('âŒ Socket connection error:', err);
        });

        socket.on('data-updated', (data) => {
            if (data.type === 'appointment') {
                console.log('ðŸ“… Appointment updated, reloading page...');
                window.location.reload();
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
